### My shortlist

| Firm | Why I’d consider them | Best suited to |
|---|---|---|

| **Hall Payne Lawyers Hobart** | Established personal-injury firm with a Hobart office and specific expertise in **superannuation, TPD and income-protection claims**. ### 1. Firths — my pick for a TPD-only matter

[Firths TPD & Superannuation claims](https://www.firths.com.au/services/523/supertpd-claims?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Firths stands out because this isn't merely one service among dozens: they have a substantial dedicated **superannuation/TPD practice**. They specifically deal with TPD, super claims, income protection, rejected TPD claims and private/retail disability insurance. They also say their lawyers have taken TPD matters to court and have obtained a number of significant judgments. [www.firths.com.au](https://www.firths.com.au/services/523/supertpd-claims?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Their Hobart office is **Level 3, 85 Macquarie Street**, and they advertise a no-win-no-fee arrangement and free claim assessment. [www.firths.com.au](https://www.firths.com.au/offices/41/hobart?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

One thing I particularly like: they say the **lawyer remains the main point of contact** rather than passing the matter primarily to a legal assistant. [www.firths.com.au](https://www.firths.com.au/offices/41/hobart?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.firths.com.au](https://www.firths.com.au/services/523/supertpd-claims?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### 2. LHD Lawyers — very strong alternative

[LHD Lawyers Hobart TPD claims](https://www.lhd.com.au/office-location/tas/hobart/tpd-superannuation-claims/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

LHD has a dedicated Hobart TPD/superannuation claims page and says its lawyers handle these claims regularly, including dealing with the super fund, insurer and paperwork. Its Hobart office is at **86 Collins Street**. [www.lhd.com.au](https://www.lhd.com.au/office-location/tas/hobart/tpd-superannuation-claims/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

The local business listing currently shows **4.8/5 from 127 reviews**, which is also a useful signal when comparing client experience. LHD Lawyers Hobart

### 3. Hall Payne — worth getting a quote from

[Hall Payne Tasmania personal injury practice](https://hallpayne.com.au/areas-of-practice/personal-injury/tas/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Hall Payne's Hobart practice specifically lists **superannuation and disability insurance matters, including TPD and income protection**. [hallpayne.com.au](https://hallpayne.com.au/areas-of-practice/personal-injury/tas/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) Their Hobart office is at **45 Murray Street**, and the current business listing shows 4.8/5 from 99 reviews. Hall Payne Lawyers Hobart

### What I'd do

If this were **my TPD claim**, I'd get **two free assessments before signing anything**:

1. **Firths** — because of their unusually strong TPD/superannuation specialisation.
2. **LHD** — to get a second assessment of the prospects and likely payout.

I'd then compare not just the headline "no win, no fee", but **exactly what you pay if you win**, including legal fees, disbursements, GST and whether any costs are recoverable from the insurer.

Also, don't assume you have only one possible claim. Depending on your employment and super history, you may potentially have **TPD cover in more than one super fund**, and there may also be income-protection or separate retail insurance involved. Firths specifically says it investigates multiple super funds where applicable. [www.firths.com.au](https://www.firths.com.au/offices/41/hobart?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.firths.com.au](https://www.firths.com.au/services/523/supertpd-claims?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me **(a) which super fund you're with, (b) whether your TPD claim has already been lodged/rejected, and (c) roughly what condition prevents you working**, I can narrow this down to the **best 2–3 Hobart lawyers for your particular situation** and compare their fees/reviews and relevant experience.
